reviews.text: Everything was perfect! Babybel came for his first grooming and left happy and clean 🐾❤️! The team was kind and very friendly. We'll be back.
Thank you so much for your 5 stars! Looking forward to seeing you again.
Very satisfied with the grooming of our Bichon Frise. We will be back.

I wholeheartedly recommend this groomer!

I contacted her in a complete panic because I couldn't brush my little Spitz. After reading so much online about the risks of matting and the consequences it could have on her coat, I was really worried and felt overwhelmed.

Despite already having a full schedule, she took the time to offer to come in at the end of the day, after her appointments, just to help us. She examined Bahia very gently, showed me the correct brushing techniques, gave me lots of advice, and, most importantly, restored my confidence. Thanks to her, I realized I was capable of taking proper care of her.

She even took the time to give her a little grooming around her rear end, without asking for anything in return. And to top it all off, I left with an adorable little bracelet given to me by her daughter, a thoughtful gesture that really touched me.

Beyond her skills, she is a deeply caring, passionate, and generous person. You can tell she genuinely loves animals and cares for their owners as well.

I left feeling much calmer and more grateful. One thing is certain: she will be Bahia's regular groomer for years to come. Thank you so much for your availability, kindness, and professionalism!
I recommend it 100% 😅❤️ Thank you so much!!!! …
I highly recommend her. My 7-month-old Maine Coon junior, who isn't usually easy to handle, was very comfortable. The groomer is honest, competent, and very professional.

I'm delighted with my little dachshund's haircut, as she didn't cope well with her first experience at another salon. I was able to stay with her throughout the entire grooming session. Eva is very gentle and attentive; I'll definitely be back!

Thank you for your 5 stars.
Looking forward to seeing you again.

For almost five years now, my little Gigi has been a regular at Couaf’toutou grooming salon. She always leaves looking very well-groomed and feels completely at ease with Eva and Corinne. The whole team is very professional and the prices are very reasonable. I highly recommend this grooming salon; you can entrust your furry, whiskered friends there with complete confidence.

A truly excellent professional.
My elderly Persian cat was groomed with the utmost care.
I felt completely at ease, and so did my cat.
Thank you so much!

I do not recommend it. The place is dirty and there's hair everywhere. They showed no gentleness or tact towards the animal. The price is excessive for such a basic service.
Never again…

At Ouaf Toutou with Eva, my Maine Coon was cared for with great gentleness and kindness. It was a truly reassuring and peaceful experience. I left very satisfied and happy with the result. I recommend them 100%! 👍 …

First grooming session for my 7-month-old kitten. He had knots along his lower back, and I thought clippers would ruin his look for a while.

Well, no, the groomer was very efficient! Gentle, energetic, and with good equipment... In no time, the knots disappeared, and his fur was smooth and soft again. A true professional who really knows cats.

I've been a customer of this grooming salon for two years now. I'm absolutely delighted with the groomer's services! Not only did she take excellent care of my pet, but she also knew how to put him at ease and reassure him throughout the entire grooming session. The result is simply impeccable; my pet looks radiant and truly happy. Furthermore, the groomer's warm welcome and professionalism completely won me over. I highly recommend her services to all pet owners who want to give their four-legged companions the very best.

Here's a before and after photo :)
Amazing haircut, excellent grooming salon, and Pika loved the treats 😃 …

Thank you to Eva and Corine for grooming our little Staffie, Snow! Our Staffie is terrified of water, and Eva and Corine made sure he felt comfortable from start to finish! Yes, it was quite a workout, but we managed, and he's all squeaky clean and beautiful! In the end, Eva and Corine both got lots of licks from Snow! We'll be back soon!

I brought my two Persians in, as I hadn't brushed them enough because of preparing for my move—and the move itself!
The younger one came out looking impeccable, and the second one needed a little extra grooming, but the groomer has the patience of a saint and respects the cats' needs.
I highly recommend her.
Terrible website! Impossible to see the prices!!!!
Perfect as always
Thank you 😊 …
They are super nice

Very satisfied with the service; the welcome was fantastic.
Karamel, my long-haired ginger cat, left the salon completely relaxed.
I recommend it 100%!
Fantastic first experience with Mochi! He felt reassured and pampered. I was able to stay with him, and the result is perfect. I'll be back and I highly recommend him!

This is a fantastic grooming salon, very welcoming. I absolutely don't regret taking my dog ​​Parker (the little clown, as they call him) there. He's quite timid, but they knew how to reassure him.
He came out looking beautiful and smelling wonderful.
Parker and I thank you for your kindness and patience.
See you soon! 🐕🐕
Go for it without hesitation! You can't find better :) My Cavalier King Charles Spaniel was thrilled to visit the shop :)

Excellent service and fantastic grooming!

I was able to get an appointment quickly thanks to a cancellation, and my dog ​​smelled wonderful afterwards, which is definitely a plus given the current weather! Thank you!

I just took Undy, my little Yorkie, to this groomer. He had a lot of work to do; he was full of knots and dreadlocks. I'm thrilled with the result; he looks beautiful and smells wonderful. Thank you for the welcome gifts! I highly recommend her.

We've been taking our Cavalier King Charles to this salon for a long time and we're always delighted! 😍 Our sweet boy comes back looking great and smelling wonderful, a fantastic haircut for a very reasonable price. THANK YOU! …

Fantastic! Eva is an incredibly kind and professional groomer. My ten-year-old golden retriever, Juju, has never been so well groomed and felt right at home. I've been to several renowned, pretentious, and very expensive Parisian groomers, and C'ouaf Toutou is in no way inferior. Truly unbeatable value for money. And what's more, Eva doesn't mind if you stay to watch the whole session! Here are a few photos (please note, grooming a golden retriever isn't spectacular, but that's precisely why it's rare to get such effective results without it looking like you have a different dog than a golden retriever 😊).
The team at C’Ouaf Toutou is wonderful; they listen to both dogs and their owners and do a fantastic job with passion and kindness. Even though we live a bit far away, we'll be back.

We've been going there for a few years now for our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, and it's always been an excellent result considering the knots and dreadlocks our dog arrives with. The staff is very friendly.
I've only been there once, unfortunately, because my beloved dog has since passed away... The staff are professionals, and you can stay, which is reassuring for our dear animals...
Fantastic groomer, very friendly and attentive! For a first experience, she managed to put my Japanese Spitz at ease; he was so proud when he left the salon!

I went there for the first time today with my little Yorkie.

It was a very good experience. Communication was easy, the welcome was pleasant, and all the dogs seemed to feel comfortable there.
I recommend it!
Very satisfied. Booking an appointment was easy, very quick and efficient.

I went there for my small pet in December 2023. The person who manages the establishment and took care of our dog was very attentive. She was quite gentle and patient with our puppy, who was only 7 months old at the time. A nice bonus is that you can stay with your pet the whole time, which is ideal for reassuring them and also for putting anxious dog owners at ease!
Everything was perfect, the price was reasonable and the cut was perfect, thank you
